forecast_provider: Project model, not a NASA prediction
brief_favorable_conditions: Cold ravine microclimate (10–18 °C), humidity > 80 %, native forest and clean streams for larvae.
why_these_variables: Cool and humid conditions and the summer-dry-season rain that keeps ravines from drying out.
absolute_value_caution: Ravine microclimate species: the regional grid cell cannot resolve shaded ravines. Prefer the change versus normal.

variables.label: Mean air temperature
variables.aggregation: Day-weighted annual mean of monthly means

variables.label: Dry-season rainfall
variables.aggregation: Annual rainfall sum over reference months [1, 2, 3, 12]; months selected using only 1981–2014, fixed for all locations.

t2m_mean.model_description: Average of the last 10 training years (assumes recent conditions persist)
t2m_mean.interval_note: Nominal 80% empirical residual band; not a calibrated guarantee. Validation windows overlap; limited residual sample.
t2m_mean.summary_text: Mean air temperature in 2026–2030 is forecast to average 11.0 °C (nominal 80% band for 2030: 10.7–11.5 °C; coverage is not guaranteed), about the same as the 1991–2020 average of 10.8 °C.

rh2m_mean.summary_text: Mean relative humidity in 2026–2030 is forecast to average 78.0 % (nominal 80% band for 2030: 75.2–78.9 %; coverage is not guaranteed), below the 1991–2020 average of 80.6 % (-2.57 %).

precip_dry_season.model_description: Robust straight line (median of pairwise slopes), less sensitive to extreme years
precip_dry_season.interval_note: Nominal 80% empirical residual band; not a calibrated guarantee. Validation windows overlap; limited residual sample.
precip_dry_season.data_caution: Reanalysis rainfall is the least reliable NASA POWER variable. Several sites show large multi-year shifts (e.g. Bramble Cay 2015–2025 about 42 % drier than 1981–2014; Monteverde dry-season rain about 3 times higher in 2009–2025 than in 1981–2008). A change-point test places these shifts in different years (1998–2015), so they do not point to a single data-source switch, but they may still be partly artificial. Rainfall forecasts that extend such shifts are uncertain: show the 80 % range and verify against local rain gauges before presenting them as fact.
precip_dry_season.summary_text: Dry-season rainfall in 2026–2030 is forecast to average 64.3 mm (nominal 80% band for 2030: 0.00–66.1 mm; coverage is not guaranteed), below the 1991–2020 average of 118.6 mm (-54.3 mm).
